rawContent: White folks who don't want to see that this verdict (+ the people like Rittenhouse who came to counter #BLM protestors) are meant to prevent us from supporting BIPOC from achieving full equality under the law and put an end to police violence should think about collateral damage.
#BlackLivesMatter allies, keep on protesting. Don't let this verdict silence you or diminish your support. That's what they want. Don't let them win.

So much for those who hope that Rittenhouse will see the error of his ways and try to atone. 

He was inspired by white nationalists and now he'll be rewarded and celebrated by them for trying to kill our right to protest. #BlackLivesMatter
